idea-plugin.name: Graylog Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
Search Graylog logs without leaving your IDE. Browse streams, follow a request, inspect event fields and highlight observed exceptions in local source files.

Code gutter markers count exceptions across the entire selected period, independent of table pagination. A background scroll export builds the complete index and retains bounded examples per source location. Selected exceptions are highlighted more strongly.

Exception messages and logged values appear beside the corresponding source lines and in gutter tooltips, including each cause in a structured exception chain.

With the PHP plugin, selected-event string values appear beside variables when the exact exception origin and a lossless constructor message template prove the argument mapping. These are historical log values; source files are never changed.

IDE-wide connections and appearance, with project-specific source mappings and log fields, are available under Settings → Tools → Graylog Explorer.

Query suggestions include log fields and severity values. Stable source colors identify services across pages. Navigate mapped local stack frames or read the exception text in a separate tab.

Filter multiple sources using a server aggregation across the selected query and time range, including sources outside the loaded message page. Source filters apply to logs and the full-period exception index.

Source checkboxes and counts are also available in the active connection tree. The Sources popup supports native title dragging, resizing with a remembered size and numeric sorting by clicking Source or Messages headers.

Maps portable source paths and language-specific text stacks. JVM package paths resolve relative to the configured local source root; source maps and live runtime variable inspection are not provided.

Supports access-token authentication, saved searches and configurable polling. Uses the Graylog legacy Search API and Search Scripting aggregation API. This is an independent, unofficial plugin.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.16.3

  • Use the shared runtime parser for JVM uncaught headers and ECS frame ordering.

0.16.2

  • Preserve explicit exception origins and keep .NET outer/inner frames attached to their own causes after the Kotlin migration.

0.16.1

  • Resize long log messages above the inspector tabs with a native divider and remember the layout.

0.16.0

  • Join adjacent visible log rows from the same source into continuous color segments, preserving selection, sorting, filtering and source identity.
  • Migrate exception parsers/models, Explorer views, connection transactions, editor hints and the panel to Kotlin; preserve stored settings and Java interoperability.

0.15.2

  • Keep JVM uncaught exceptions and their causes at their own source locations.
  • Normalize ECS runtime text through the shared Kotlin parser, including Python frame ordering.

0.15.1

  • Preserve explicit exception origins alongside caller-only text stacks.
  • Keep .NET outer and nested inner exception frames attached to their own causes.

0.15.0

  • Parse JVM, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Ruby, .NET and Rust stack frames alongside PHP; preserve original exception text.
  • Decode structured and ECS exception schemas into immutable event snapshots.
  • Share operation identities, connection credential transactions, stream loading and Explorer coordination.

0.14.0

  • Separate submitted search, paging and exception examples into a Kotlin controller with immutable operation settings.
  • Apply scoped Settings changes without unnecessary searches; preserve the submitted window and unsubmitted query draft.
  • Update editor marks by file and retain unchanged decorations, with per-editor PHP value lifecycle.
  • Use Kotlin DSL bindings for IDE/project Settings and preserve workspace history on Apply.

0.13.0

  • Separate Explorer views and background controllers; preserve query, source and time scope.
  • Use native Kotlin UI DSL forms for connections and settings.
  • Improve cancellation, retry and credential rollback; preserve connection/profile ordering.
  • Harden pagination bounds and plain-text log cells and tooltips.
  • Use one Gradle Java/Kotlin build with controller, UI and restartless-update regression tests.
